artifacts.notes: Uncorrected and uncollated OCR of the whole identified printing. No source words were generated, translated, reconstructed, or corrected by a model. 1920 first printing; the native copyright page states publication October 1920. Complete historical English translation of Singulari quadam at pp. 127–132. Ryan and Husslein are identified as anthology editors; the individual translator is unrecorded. Historical headings, bracketed glosses and notes 6 and 7 belong to this printing.
artifacts.rights_basis: Historical English translation and original printing text are public domain in the United States by expiration of the publication term of the identified pre-1931 printing, under src/sources/inventories/papal-documents-rights-v1.toml. Mechanical scanning and OCR add no original source wording. Historical/source wording is excluded from Triptych CC BY 4.0. Native PDF page 7 identifies New York: The Macmillan Company, 1920; page 8 states copyright 1920 and publication October 1920. Both and all six constituent pages were inspected. The historical anthology headings, bracketed glosses and its two notes are included as historical editorial material, not newly attributed papal wording.
